channel.title: Samira Home Decor — Home Décor, Lifestyle & Fragrance
channel.description: Curated pieces for elevated living. Shipped Australia-wide.

item.g:title: Aurelia Marble & Gold Bathroom Set (5-Piece)
item.g:description: Turn a daily routine into a five-star ritual. The Aurelia set brings hand-glazed marble ceramic and hand-painted gold veining to your basin, each piece finished with a gilded base that catches the light. A complete five-piece collection that makes even the smallest bathroom feel like a boutique hotel, choose classic white, deep emerald green or midnight black, all pooled with liquid-gold marbling.

item.g:title: Dark Marble Bathroom Set (4-Piece)
item.g:description: Cut from solid Emperador Dark marble, this is the set that makes a bathroom feel like a hotel suite. The stone is a deep espresso brown shot through with pale gold and cream veining, and because every block is quarried rather than moulded, no two pieces in your set will ever match exactly. Weighty in the hand, cool to the touch, and finished with a polished gold pump. Four pieces that sit beautifully together on a vanity, or apart across the tray by the bath, the dispenser at the basin.

item.g:title: Minimalist Pump Soap Dispenser
item.g:description: A plain, well-proportioned pump dispenser for hand soap or lotion, in a finish that doesn't shout. Two sizes, so it suits a small powder room or a busy family basin, and three colours that sit quietly against most tiles.

item.g:title: Black Marble-Look & Gold Bathroom Collection
item.g:description: Black marble-look pieces with slim gold detailing, bought individually so you take only what your basin needs. Toothbrush holders, cups, a dispenser, a cotton swab box, soap dish, tissue box and two tray sizes, all cut to the same restrained line.

item.g:title: White Marble & Gold Bathroom Collection
item.g:description: Natural white marble with gold trim, in square or round shapes depending on how soft you want the look. The veining runs differently through every piece, so a set assembled from these never looks mass-produced.

item.g:title: Two-Tone Bathroom Bin
item.g:description: A bin you don't have to hide. Clean-sided and weighted enough to stay put, in two-tone colourways with and without a lid, so it works beside a vanity or under a desk just as well.

item.g:title: Touchless Sensor Bathroom Bin
item.g:description: Opens as your hand approaches and closes itself afterwards, which matters more in a bathroom than anywhere else in the house. Fully waterproof, in round, oval and square shapes, at 10 or 15 litres.

item.g:title: Emerald Marble Bathroom Accessories
item.g:description: Deep green natural marble with pale veining running through it, which is a far braver choice than white and looks remarkable against brass tapware. Square or round pieces, bought one at a time.

item.g:title: Fluted Sandstone-Look Bathroom Accessories
item.g:description: Bevelled vertical grooves give these pieces their texture, catching the light down the sides so a plain basin suddenly has something to look at. In marble white and warmer sandstone tones.

item.g:title: Sandstone Bathroom Collection
item.g:description: Premium sandstone, where the texture is the whole point: matte, grainy and warm rather than polished and cold. Buy the complete set, or add pieces one at a time.

item.g:title: Black Marble Bathroom Accessories Collection
item.g:description: Black natural marble with your choice of gold or silver fittings, which is the detail that decides whether a bathroom reads warm or cool. Each piece is cut from stone, so the veining is never repeated.

item.g:title: Crystal Glass Bathroom Accessories
item.g:description: Crystal glass with faceted sides that throw light around a basin the way cut glass does on a dining table. Five styles to choose between, all finished to the same standard.

item.g:title: Countertop Hand Towel Rack
item.g:description: A 32cm standing rack for the bench or vanity, so a hand towel has somewhere to live that isn't the edge of the basin. Black, gold or silver.

item.g:title: Egyptian Cotton Towel Set (700GSM, 3-Piece)
item.g:description: 700GSM Egyptian cotton, which is the weight where a towel stops being thin and starts feeling like a hotel. Three pieces per set, in six colours, absorbent from the first wash and soft after many.

item.g:title: Black & White Veined Bathroom Collection
item.g:description: A black finish with white veining running across it, which reads as marble from across the room and costs considerably less. The tray pulls the set together on a vanity.

item.g:title: Travertine Bathroom Collection
item.g:description: Travertine has an open, pitted texture that reads as old-world rather than glossy, and it suits a bathroom that's meant to feel calm. The widest set of pieces we carry, including a storage container and two soap dish shapes.

item.g:title: Rose Gold Bathroom Accessories Set
item.g:description: Rose gold detailing across a four-piece set: toothbrush holder, dispenser, soap dish and cup. Take the set, or fill a gap with a single piece.

item.g:title: Expandable Bamboo Bath Caddy
item.g:description: Extends to fit across the bath, then holds a book, a glass and a candle where you can reach them. Bamboo, so it copes with the steam, in white or black.

item.g:title: Clear Cosmetic Storage Box
item.g:description: A clear box that keeps brushes, lipsticks and skincare upright and visible instead of rolling loose in a drawer. Two sizes, and tidy enough to leave out on the vanity.

item.g:title: Glass Bathroom Accessories Set (4-Piece)
item.g:description: Four pieces in high-quality glass, in black or white, with the weight and clarity that cheap acrylic never manages. A whole basin dressed in one purchase.

item.g:title: Ceramic Marble-Look Bathroom Set (5-Piece)
item.g:description: Five ceramic pieces finished to look like marble, with gold accents, in emerald green, snow white or black. All the drama of stone, at a fraction of the price and weight.

item.g:title: Marble & Copper Floor Towel Holder
item.g:description: A freestanding towel holder on a solid marble base with copper rods, heavy enough to stay exactly where you put it. The piece that makes a bathroom look finished rather than furnished.

item.g:title: Porcelain Bathroom Set (5-Piece)
item.g:description: Five porcelain pieces with clean lines and nothing superfluous, made to work together on a single vanity.

item.g:title: Ceramic Bathroom Accessories Collection
item.g:description: Good ceramic in silver, white or gold trims, sold piece by piece: dispenser, cup and holder. The easy way to replace one tired item without rebuying the lot.

item.g:title: Marble-Base Rotating Vanity Mirror
item.g:description: A vanity mirror on a marble base that turns to the angle you need and stays there. Heavy enough not to creep across the bench while you use it.

item.g:title: Marble Toiletry Collection
item.g:description: Marble pieces at a larger scale than most: two tissue box designs, a generous tray, dispensers in gold or silver. For a bathroom with the bench space to carry them.

item.g:title: Expandable Timber Bath Caddy
item.g:description: Solid timber that extends across the bath, with room for a book, a glass and whatever else turns a bath into an hour to yourself.

item.g:title: Luxe Bathroom Set (4-Piece)
item.g:description: A four-piece set in two arrangements, made to dress a whole basin at once rather than be collected slowly.

item.g:title: Gilded Bathroom Accessories Set (4-Piece)
item.g:description: Four pieces with gilded detailing, available as a set or individually, so a single soap dish can be replaced without starting again.

item.g:title: Three-Tier Standing Towel Rack
item.g:description: Three hanging levels on a freestanding frame, which is what a family bathroom actually needs: somewhere for three towels to dry properly rather than overlap on one rail.

item.g:title: Stainless Steel & Marble Towel Holder
item.g:description: Stainless steel rods on a marble foot: the steel handles the damp, the marble handles the standing still. Black or brushed gold.

item.g:title: Beige Bathroom Set (5-Piece)
item.g:description: Five pieces in a soft beige that works with timber vanities and warm tiles, where a stark white set would look cold.

item.g:title: Tree Branch Wall Hook (78cm)
item.g:description: A branching wall hook, 78cm long, that holds robes, towels and bags without looking like hardware. Black with gold.

item.g:title: Dual-Rod Rotating Towel Rack
item.g:description: Two rods that rotate independently, so towels can be spread out to dry rather than bunched together. Silver or gold.

item.g:title: Standing Stainless Steel Towel Rack
item.g:description: A simple standing rack in stainless steel, which is the material that survives a wet bathroom without rusting at the joints. Black, brushed gold or brushed silver.

item.g:title: Two-Bar Floor Towel Rack with Storage
item.g:description: Two sturdy bars for towels with storage built into the frame below, so the bathroom gains a shelf as well as a rail.

item.g:title: Marble-Base Vertical Towel Rack
item.g:description: A tall vertical rack on a marble base, which keeps the footprint small while holding full-size bath towels. Black.

item.g:title: Modern Bath Accessories Collection
item.g:description: Clean lines and a contemporary finish across a cotton swab box, dispenser, soap dish and tray. Unfussy pieces for a bathroom that doesn't want a theme.

item.g:title: Matte Bathroom Accessories Set (5-Piece)
item.g:description: A five-piece set in a soft matte finish, in grey or sandstone, that hides water spots far better than anything glossy.

item.g:title: Veined Marble Bathroom Accessories
item.g:description: Premium marble with pronounced veining, including two tray sizes for whatever bench space you have. Sold piece by piece.

item.g:title: Faceted Ceramic Bathroom Set (5-Piece)
item.g:description: Five ceramic pieces with faceted, polygonal sides that give a plain white or black set some shape and shadow.

item.g:title: Natural Marble Bathroom Accessories
item.g:description: Genuine marble, including a diffuser and a generous tray alongside the usual pieces, so the whole vanity can be in one stone.

item.g:title: Ceramic Bathroom Set (4-Piece)
item.g:description: Four premium ceramic pieces in green or coffee, a quieter palette than the usual white and gold.

item.g:title: Crystal Glass Bathroom Set (4-Piece)
item.g:description: Four pieces in crystal glass, bought together, for a vanity that catches the light every time someone walks past.

item.g:title: Corner Towel Rack (40 × 50cm)
item.g:description: Built for the corner that nothing else fits, 40 by 50cm, keeping towels off the floor and out of the way. Black or gold.

item.g:title: Granite-Look Bathroom Set (4-Piece)
item.g:description: Four pieces in a granite-look finish, including a toilet brush, which most sets quietly leave out.

item.g:title: Deep-Seat Family Sofa
item.g:description: Built for the household where everyone piles on at once: a deep seat, a soft back and widths right up to 260cm. Beige, which is the colour that forgives a family.

item.g:title: Modular Sofa with Chaise Options
item.g:description: A modular sofa that scales from a 110cm two-seater to a 320cm run with a chaise, so it fits the room you have now and the one you move to later. Several colourways.

item.g:title: Low-Line Linen Lounge Sofa
item.g:description: A low, lounging sofa in linen with feather-filled cushions, the sort you sink into rather than perch on. Single and double modules plus small widths for a reading corner.

item.g:title: Square-Stitched L-Shape Sofa
item.g:description: Clean square stitching across generous cushions, in a three seater or an L-shape that turns a corner properly. Armchair and footstool to match.

item.g:title: Velvet Sofa Collection
item.g:description: Velvet over high-density foam, in green, red or ivory, at widths from 110cm to 280cm. The colours are the point here: a velvet sofa is the piece a room gets built around.

item.g:title: Modular Leather Sectional Sofa
item.g:description: Leather on a timber frame in a modular sectional layout, from a single seater to 330cm. Minimalist enough to disappear into a room, substantial enough to last in it.

item.g:title: Velvet Sofa with Chaise
item.g:description: Velvet across a timber frame, in widths to 300cm with chaise versions for the end of a long room. The armchair matches if you want a pair.

item.g:title: Curved Sofa in Black
item.g:description: A curved back that softens a square room, in black, at widths from 120cm right up to 310cm. The curve is what makes it feel designed rather than bought.

item.g:title: Wide Chaise Sofa Collection
item.g:description: Very wide seating with chaise options up to 340cm plus a 160cm chaise, for the living room that doubles as the place everyone falls asleep.

item.g:title: Modular Sofa with Footstool
item.g:description: Modular seating on a timber frame with high-density foam, from 120cm to 280cm, with a footstool that doubles as extra seating when people arrive.

item.g:title: Velvet Modular Sofa
item.g:description: Velvet, modular, and available up to 320cm, so a big room gets filled without three separate purchases. Armchair and footstool complete it.

item.g:title: Bouclé Fabric Sofa
item.g:description: Soft bouclé in white or grey, at 105cm through to 240cm. The texture does the work: no pattern, no trim, just a quiet, tactile surface.

item.g:title: Compact Three-Size Sofa
item.g:description: A straightforward sofa in three sensible sizes, on a timber frame with high-density foam. For the room that needs a good sofa, not a statement.

item.g:title: Low Lounger Modular Sofa
item.g:description: Low modules in off white that you arrange yourself: single, double and corner pieces, for a lounge that sits closer to the floor.

item.g:title: Real Leather Sofa with Footstool
item.g:description: Real leather in black, olive and ocean green, from a 100cm footstool up to full-length seating. Leather that will look better in five years than it does today.

item.g:title: Down-Filled Modular Sectional
item.g:description: Down-filled cushions on a modular sectional, up to 360cm with a 150cm chaise. Soft enough that people stop sitting and start lying down.

item.g:title: Premium Velvet Chaise Sofa
item.g:description: Premium velvet on a timber frame, in widths to 320cm with chaise versions. The armchair and footstool match for a full setting.

item.g:title: Two-Tone Cotton Sofa Collection
item.g:description: Dusty grey paired with ivory, in cotton, from 120cm to 285cm. The two-tone treatment stops a large sofa reading as a single heavy block.

item.g:title: Floating Ash Timber & Leather Sofa
item.g:description: Leather seating that appears to float on a premium ash timber base, in widths to 320cm. The detail is in the gap between frame and cushion.

item.g:title: Sculptural Curved Sofa
item.g:description: A curved, sculptural shape in three sizes, from a 90cm loveseat to a 240cm three seater. Looks considered from every angle, which matters in an open-plan room.

item.g:title: Wide-Cushion Velvet Sofa
item.g:description: Luxuriously wide cushions in velvet, from 170cm to 340cm. Fewer, bigger cushions means fewer seams and a cleaner line.

item.g:title: Colour-Block Sofa Collection
item.g:description: An unusual shape in yellow or white, from a single seater to 200cm. For a room that wants some personality rather than another beige three seater.

item.g:title: Modular Leather & Ash Sofa
item.g:description: Leather modules on an ash timber frame, up to 360cm, arranged how you like. Armchair and footstool available separately.

item.g:title: Leather Sofa in Four Colours
item.g:description: Leather in green, beige, navy or grey, at 145cm, 215cm or 260cm. The colour range is wider than most leather sofas offer.

item.g:title: Italian-Style Leather Sectional
item.g:description: A sectional in charcoal grey or grey leather, from 105cm to 280cm, with the restrained lines of Italian design.

item.g:title: Bouclé Sofa with Footstool
item.g:description: Bouclé on a timber frame, at 180cm, 240cm or 270cm, with or without the matching footstool. There is also a 90 by 90cm corner piece.

item.g:title: Curved Leather Sofa
item.g:description: Leather with a curved back on a timber frame, from a single seater to 230cm. High-density foam keeps the curve from collapsing over time.

item.g:title: Classic Leather Sofa
item.g:description: A classic leather sofa in four sizes, from an 86cm chair to a 235cm three seater, on a timber frame.

item.g:title: Curved Velvet Modular Sofa
item.g:description: Velvet, curved and modular, in widths from 160cm to 320cm, with an armchair and an occasional chair that match. The widest choice of sizes we carry.

item.g:title: Velvet & Linen Sofa
item.g:description: Velvet and linen together on a timber frame, in four sizes. Two textures in one piece, which stops a big sofa looking flat.

item.g:title: Leather Sofa & Armchair
item.g:description: Leather on a timber frame, from a single chair to 280cm, with high-density foam that holds its shape.

item.g:title: Everyday Fabric Sofa
item.g:description: A plain, well-made fabric sofa in three sizes, including an 80cm chair. The sensible choice for a first home or a second living room.

item.g:title: Curved Lounge Sofa in Six Colours
item.g:description: A curved lounge sofa on a timber frame, in brown, green, pink, white and more, at 150cm or 200cm. The colour choice is unusually broad.

item.g:title: Tan Leather Sofa
item.g:description: Tan leather on timber, in seven widths from 130cm to 353cm. Tan is the leather that warms a room rather than darkening it.

item.g:title: Leather Sofa with Long Chaise
item.g:description: Leather seating with a 165cm chaise, in overall lengths to 400cm. For the room with a long wall and nothing on it.

item.g:title: Full-Grain Look Leather Sofa
item.g:description: Tan leather in eight widths from 120cm to 280cm, so it fits a snug or a formal lounge equally.

item.g:title: Velvet Sofa in Five Sizes
item.g:description: Velvet over high-density foam, in white or green, from 210cm to 330cm. Large sizes only, for rooms that can take them.

item.g:title: Sectional Sofa Modules
item.g:description: Buy the modules and build the shape: 80cm, 120cm, 160cm and 200cm pieces in two arrangements. The flexible answer to an awkward room.

item.g:title: Oversized Beige Sofa
item.g:description: Beige, and very large: 240cm to 360cm. A sofa for a room where a normal three seater would look lost.

item.g:title: Linen Sofa with Timber Frame
item.g:description: Linen over a timber frame with high-density foam, in three sizes. Linen creases, softens and looks better for it.

item.g:title: Bouclé Sofa in Ten Sizes
item.g:description: Bouclé on a timber frame in ten widths from 120cm to 390cm, which is the broadest size range in the range.

item.g:title: Large Leather Lounge Sofa
item.g:description: Leather on timber in four large sizes, 230cm to 320cm, for a lounge that seats everyone at once.

item.g:title: Curved Bouclé Sofa
item.g:description: A curved bouclé sofa in three sizes. The combination of curve and texture is what makes it feel expensive.

item.g:title: Down-Filled Pull Sofa
item.g:description: Down and cotton filling in widths from a 125cm single seater to 385cm. Soft rather than firm, and it shows: these cushions need plumping.

item.g:title: Single-Armrest Chaise Sofa
item.g:description: A single-armrest design in leather and linen, from 300cm to 365cm, so one end stays open for stretching out.

item.g:title: Four-Colour Fabric Sofa
item.g:description: Fabric at 260cm or 280cm, in grey, light grey, off white or emerald green. Emerald is the one worth being brave about.

item.g:title: Two-Colour Lounge Sofa
item.g:description: White or green, at 220cm, 280cm or 320cm. Large, simple and easy to live with.

item.g:title: Extended Leather Sofa
item.g:description: Leather on a timber frame in nine widths, 190cm all the way to 410cm. The longest sofa in the range.

item.g:title: Three-Colour Statement Sofa
item.g:description: Ivory, red or green, at 280cm to 350cm. Red is rarely offered at this size, and it transforms a room.

item.g:title: Curved Sofa in Three Colours
item.g:description: A curved sofa in charcoal grey, beige or peach, at 200cm or 300cm. Peach is softer in a room than it sounds on paper.

item.g:title: Lambswool Sofa
item.g:description: Lambswool on a timber frame, in four sizes. Warm underhand in a way that flat-weave fabric never is.

item.g:title: Two-Tone Wide Sofa
item.g:description: Blue or beige at 240cm and 260cm. Wide, low and straightforward.

item.g:title: Configurable Leather Sofa
item.g:description: Leather in three configurations, A, B and C, across brown, light grey and charcoal. Pick the layout, then the colour.

item.g:title: Velvet Sofa, White or Green
item.g:description: Velvet at 180cm, 230cm or 260cm, in white or green. Velvet at a size that suits an ordinary room rather than a ballroom.

item.g:title: Curved Fabric Sofa
item.g:description: A curved fabric sofa on a timber frame with high-density foam, in three sizes.

item.g:title: Oversized Bouclé Sofa
item.g:description: Bouclé in navy blue or snow beige, at 280cm, 310cm or 420cm. Very large, very soft.

item.g:title: Feather-Filled Sofa in Four Colours
item.g:description: Feather and down filling in grey, blue, tan or chocolate, from 280cm to 330cm. The softest seat in the range.

item.g:title: Rounded Velvet Sofa
item.g:description: Velvet in chocolate, mocha or grey, at 180cm or 200cm, with softly rounded arms and back.

item.g:title: Extra-Large Lounge Sofa
item.g:description: 320, 370 or 420cm across and 245cm deep. This is a sofa for a room you could park a car in, and it will swallow a family whole.

item.g:title: Long Leather Sofa
item.g:description: Leather on a timber frame in seven lengths from 260cm to 360cm, all of them long.

item.g:title: Glass Coffee & Side Table Set
item.g:description: Glass in a small and large size, bought separately or as the pair. Glass keeps a room feeling open, which matters when the sofa is already substantial.

item.g:title: Round Travertine Coffee & Side Table
item.g:description: Travertine in black or white, from a 50cm side table to a 90cm coffee table. The stone's open grain gives a plain round shape something to look at.

item.g:title: Three-Size Round Coffee Table
item.g:description: One shape in three sizes, 45cm, 90cm and 100cm, so it works as a side table, a centrepiece, or both together.

item.g:title: Round Timber Coffee & Side Table
item.g:description: Solid timber in two heights, the lower as a coffee table and the taller as a side table beside a chair.

item.g:title: Round Oak Coffee Table & Nest
item.g:description: Oak at 90cm and 50cm, sold apart or as a set that nests together when the floor is needed.

item.g:title: Colour-Choice Coffee Table
item.g:description: Green, black, white or beige, in small or large. Most coffee tables come in one neutral; this one lets you pick a colour and commit.

item.g:title: Tinted Glass Coffee Table
item.g:description: Tinted glass in black or chocolate, which reads far richer than clear glass and hides fingerprints better too.

item.g:title: Marble & Glass Rectangular Coffee Table
item.g:description: Marble paired with glass across 130cm and 140cm, with a 30cm side table in the same language.

item.g:title: Oak Coffee Table Pair
item.g:description: Two oak tables at 80cm and 50cm, which can sit side by side or in different corners of the same room.

item.g:title: Marble Nesting Coffee Tables
item.g:description: Three marble tables, A, B and C, bought singly or as a complete set that nests into one footprint.

item.g:title: Stainless Steel Coffee Table Set
item.g:description: Stainless steel sets at 80cm, 90cm and 100cm, with the mirror finish that lifts a dark room.

item.g:title: Square Glass Coffee Table
item.g:description: A square glass table in black or white at 80cm, 100cm or 120cm. Square suits a square sofa arrangement better than a round table does.

item.g:title: Stone & Steel Coffee Table
item.g:description: Stone on stainless steel, in black or gold. The weight sits in the top, the lightness in the base.

item.g:title: Two-Piece Coffee Table Set
item.g:description: A set in 100cm, 120cm or 130cm, designed to sit together or be split across the room.

item.g:title: Round Timber Coffee Table
item.g:description: A single round timber table with nothing to decide: one size, one finish, good grain.

item.g:title: Solid Timber Coffee Table (95cm)
item.g:description: 95cm of solid timber, substantial enough to anchor a three seater without crowding it.

item.g:title: Nesting Travertine Coffee Tables
item.g:description: Travertine on timber at 90cm and 110cm, made to nest. Two tables when you entertain, one when you don't.

item.g:title: Round Stone & Glass Coffee Table
item.g:description: Stone and glass together in three diameters, 80, 90 and 100cm.

item.g:title: Steel Coffee Table Set, Gold or Black
item.g:description: A steel set in gold or black. Gold warms a neutral room; black disappears into one.

item.g:title: Complete Coffee Table Set
item.g:description: A full set bought in one go, so the tables match each other properly rather than nearly.

item.g:title: Marble & Timber Coffee Table
item.g:description: Marble over timber in white or grey, at 100cm, 110cm or 120cm. The timber keeps the marble from feeling cold.

item.g:title: Travertine Round Coffee Table
item.g:description: Solid travertine in three diameters, 70, 80 and 90cm. One block of stone, no veneer.

item.g:title: Marble, Steel & Glass Coffee Table Set
item.g:description: Three materials in one set, at 90cm, 100cm or 120cm. Busier than most, and striking for it.

item.g:title: Slate & Metal Coffee Table Set
item.g:description: Slate tops on metal, in gold or black. Slate is darker and more matte than marble, and hides a wine ring better.

item.g:title: Bronze or Silver Coffee Table Set
item.g:description: A metal set in bronze or silver, for a room that can carry a metallic centrepiece.

item.g:title: Marble-Top Coffee Table with Metal Base
item.g:description: Marble at 120cm or 130cm on a black or gold metal base, with the option of the table alone or the full set.

item.g:title: Rotating Walnut & Marble Coffee Table
item.g:description: A square walnut table with a rotating marble section, so the surface turns toward whoever needs it.

item.g:title: Metal Coffee Table, Silver or Black
item.g:description: Metal at 100cm or 130cm, in silver or black, with a slim profile that suits a smaller room.

item.g:title: Marble & Ash Coffee Table
item.g:description: Marble over ash timber: pale stone, pale wood, and a quiet result.

item.g:title: Marble Coffee Table Set
item.g:description: A complete marble set, bought together so the veining and tone are consistent across pieces.

item.g:title: Glass & Steel Coffee Table Set
item.g:description: Glass on stainless steel at 120cm, 130cm or 140cm. Large tables that still feel light.

item.g:title: Round Oak & Steel Coffee Table Set
item.g:description: Oak and steel in round sets at 80cm, 90cm and 100cm, warm and hard-wearing together.

item.g:title: Round Walnut & Glass Coffee Table
item.g:description: Walnut and glass in a single round design, dark timber under clear glass.

item.g:title: White Marble Coffee Table
item.g:description: White marble, plainly done. The stone is the whole design.

item.g:title: Snow White Stone Coffee Table Set
item.g:description: A stone set in snow white on metal, bright enough to lift a dark-floored room.

item.g:title: Oval Marble Coffee Table Set
item.g:description: Oval marble with gold or black detail, at 120cm or 130cm. Oval is the shape to choose when children are learning to walk.

item.g:title: Oak & Stone Coffee Table
item.g:description: Oak with stone at 120cm or 130cm, in white or white and tan.

item.g:title: Rectangular Marble Coffee Table
item.g:description: Rectangular marble at 90cm or 120cm, which suits a long sofa better than a round table.

item.g:title: Tan & White Marble Coffee Table
item.g:description: Marble over timber in tan and white, the two tones meeting across the top.

item.g:title: Round Gold & Glass Coffee Table Set
item.g:description: Gold stainless steel with glass, as a complete round set. Unapologetically glamorous.

item.g:title: Solid Travertine Round Coffee Table
item.g:description: One piece of travertine, round, with the pitted texture the stone is known for.

item.g:title: Steel Coffee Table Set (Three Sizes)
item.g:description: Steel sets at 80cm, 90cm and 100cm, simple and hard-wearing.

item.g:title: Round Marble & Gold Coffee Table
item.g:description: White marble on gold stainless steel, round. The most classic combination here.

item.g:title: Emerald Marble Coffee Table
item.g:description: Emerald marble with glass, as a single table or the full set. Green marble is rarer and reads as a deliberate choice.

item.g:title: Solid Walnut Coffee Table

item.g:title: Steel Fire Pit with Built-In Log Store
item.g:description: The reason everyone ends up outside. A broad steel fire bowl sits at the centre of a sculptural low table, with the firewood stacked in the open curve beneath it, so the fuel is part of the design rather than something to hide. The surround gives you somewhere to rest drinks, a board or a hand while the fire does the work. Stainless steel under a textured, heat-resistant black powder coat, built to live outside through an Australian winter. Five diameters, from 80cm for a courtyard to 150cm for a lawn that gathers a crowd, with matching seats sold separately.

item.g:title: Caged Solar Garden Lantern
item.g:description: A slender cage of stainless steel ribs around a column of warm light, charged by the sun and switched on by the dusk. No cable to run, no socket to find, so it can stand where you actually want light: along a path, beside the steps, at the end of a daybed, in a planter among the greenery. The frame is weather-resistant and heavy enough not to wander in the wind, and the glow is warm rather than blue-white, so an evening outside still feels like an evening. Three sizes, lovely in a row or in a cluster of mixed heights.

item.g:title: Rattan Outdoor Lounge Chair, Ottoman & Side Table
item.g:description: Built for the balcony, the courtyard and the shady corner that never quite had the right chair. This setting is woven in weather-resistant rattan over a steel frame, with a high curved back that cradles your shoulders and a seat deep enough to stay in. The ottoman slides under when you want the floor back, and doubles as a low table for a drink and a book. Buy the chair on its own, add the ottoman for proper lounging, or take all three and have a corner that's finished.

item.g:title: Teak & Metal Outdoor Dining Collection
item.g:description: Solid teak over a steel base, which is the combination that survives summers outside and still looks good doing it. The timber is warm and open-grained, the kind that silvers gracefully if you let it, and the metal base keeps the whole table steady on decking or pavers. Choose the shape your space wants: a round or square table for four, or a long dining table at 160, 220 or 260cm for the gatherings that run past dark. Chairs are priced individually, so you buy exactly the number you seat.

item.g:title: Weatherproof Rattan Outdoor Lounge Collection
item.g:description: A full outdoor living room you can build up a piece at a time. This collection is woven in weatherproof rattan over a sturdy frame, in a clean modern line that sits as happily by a pool as on a terrace. Start with a chair, add the deep sofa chair and footstool for the end of the day, stretch out on the sun lounge, or bring in the two seater when there's always someone staying. In chocolate for a darker, more grounded look, or beige to keep things light and coastal.

item.g:title: Curved Sun Lounge with Sculptural Base
item.g:description: A sun lounge with a curve to it, shaped so your back is supported whether you're reading or dozing. The hollow sculptural base lifts it off the ground and makes it look like a piece of furniture rather than a poolside afterthought, and the matching side table keeps a drink within arm's reach. In champagne or white, both of which sit well beside water and pale paving.

item.g:title: Grey Rattan Outdoor Sofa & Armchair Setting
item.g:description: A grey rattan setting that does the whole corner: armchair, sofa in two lengths, and a table to pull between them. The weave is fine and even, the tone is a soft mid-grey rather than the orange-brown of cheaper rattan, and the proportions are generous enough that people stay put. Buy the pieces as your space allows.

item.g:title: Modular Outdoor Sofa Collection
item.g:description: Clean-lined modular seating for an outdoor room you build yourself: single, two or three seater, with a choice of two tables. The frames are substantial, the cushions deep, and the khaki and grey colourways both sit quietly against greenery and stone. Start with a single seater and add as the space asks for it.

item.g:title: Cushioned Outdoor Lounge Chair & Footstool
item.g:description: A lounge chair with plush cushions and a quiet, timeless frame, the sort you end up reading in for an hour longer than you planned. Take the chair on its own, or the set with its matching footstool for a proper afternoon. Khaki or black, both easy to live with.

item.g:title: Leaf-Shaped Sun Lounge
item.g:description: Shaped after a leaf, which sounds fanciful until you lie on one: the curve holds your shoulders and knees exactly where they want to be. A sculptural piece that earns its spot by the pool or under a tree, in coffee or beige, and in two sizes so it suits the space you have.

item.g:title: Streamlined Outdoor Coffee Table
item.g:description: A low, streamlined coffee table that gives an outdoor lounge its centre. The surface is broad enough for a tray, a stack of books and a pot of something green, and the simple silhouette keeps the focus on the seating around it. White or grey.

item.g:title: Handwoven Rattan Resort Chair
item.g:description: Handwoven rattan with a resort feel, the kind of chair you see on a terrace in the south of France. Sleek enough to pull up to a dining table, comfortable enough to leave in a corner with a cushion. Three colourways, including a two-tone black and tan.

item.g:title: Patterned Handwoven Outdoor Chair
item.g:description: The intricate handwoven pattern is what you notice first, catching the light differently through the day and giving an outdoor setting some texture to look at. Underneath it is a solid, comfortable chair that will take whatever the season does to it. Khaki or black.

item.g:title: Shaded Two-in-One Outdoor Lounge
item.g:description: A two-in-one lounge with its own overhead shade: sit under it through the middle of the day, fold it back when you want the sun. A generous piece for a poolside or a lawn, with a matching coffee table if you want the full setting.

item.g:title: Oval-Base Lounge Chair & Coffee Table Set
item.g:description: The chair is the statement here: an oval hollow base that reads as sculpture from across the garden, with a seat deep enough to actually live in. Take one chair, one chair with the coffee table, or a pair with the table for a corner that's finished.

item.g:title: Solid Teak Outdoor Sofa
item.g:description: The centrepiece sofa, built on a solid teak base with the proportions of indoor furniture. Generous, low and quietly expensive-looking, it anchors a large terrace the way a good sofa anchors a living room. One piece, no compromises.

item.g:title: Rattan Hanging Swing Chair
item.g:description: A rattan swing chair with a soft cotton cushion, hung for gentle movement rather than theatrics. Put it on a covered deck or in a corner of the garden and it will be the seat everyone reaches for first.

item.g:title: Woven String Sculptural Outdoor Chair
item.g:description: Hundreds of woven strings arranged across a sculptural outer frame, so the chair throws a pattern of light and shadow as the sun moves. As much a design piece as a seat, in ivory and tan that suits a pale, coastal palette.

item.g:title: Fibre Rattan Hanging Chair with Alloy Frame
item.g:description: Fibre rattan over an aluminium alloy frame, which means it's light to move, strong to sit in, and happy indoors or out. A hanging chair for a reading corner, a balcony or a shaded part of the garden.

item.g:title: Handcrafted Teak Outdoor Dining Collection
item.g:description: Handcrafted teak dining, from a coffee table up to a 300cm table that seats a proper gathering. The timber is warm and open-grained, the chairs are made to match, and the whole collection ages into that soft silver teak colour if you let it.

item.g:title: Premium Teak Outdoor Dining Table & Chairs
item.g:description: Premium teak, a generous table and chairs cut to match it. Simple, heavy, well-made outdoor dining that doesn't try to be clever and will still be here in ten years.

item.g:title: Teak & Rattan Outdoor Sofa Collection
item.g:description: A solid teak frame with rattan detailing woven into it, so you get the warmth of timber and the texture of weave in one piece. Single and double seaters, a double with table, and a three seater with chaise for the long end of a terrace.

item.g:title: Aluminium & Rattan Outdoor Sofa Collection
item.g:description: A sleek aluminium frame with rattan detail: light to move, rust-resistant, and modern without being cold. Singles through to a three seater, with small and large tables to match.

item.g:title: Alban Bouclé Pillow Cover
item.g:description: Wrap your space in texture. The Alban cushion cover is crafted from a deep, curly bouclé with a soft, teddy-like pile that instantly adds warmth and understated luxury to sofas, beds, benches and reading nooks. In a considered palette of seven rich tones, from berry red to sage, soft blush and espresso, it layers effortlessly with linen, wool and neutrals to refresh a room in seconds. A concealed zip keeps the finish clean and makes seasonal swaps easy, and because it's sold as a cover only (insert not included), you can restyle again and again without the bulk.

item.g:title: Fleur Sculptural Glass Vase
item.g:description: The Fleur glass vase brings sculptural charm to any room with a wavy silhouette that resembles an open flower. This visual statement piece is a work of art and enhances any floral arrangement you choose. Made from glass and designed for tabletop display, it suits both real and everlasting flowers. Place it on a dining table, bedside table, coffee table or kitchen bench to create an effortless centrepiece, or let it stand alone to add sculptural interest to a living space and brighten your home.

item.g:title: Ceramic Electric Oil Vaporiser
item.g:description: Bring a subtle, calming fragrance to any room with this ceramic electric oil vaporiser that gently warms essential oils without harming them. Designed to run safely for long periods, it emits heat only from the recessed bowl, so the outer surface stays cool to the touch. No water is needed, making it a drip-free option ideal for aromatherapy at night or when hosting friends, creating a calm, fragrant atmosphere in living areas, bedrooms and for quiet evenings.

item.g:title: Diamond Velvet Throw Pillow Cover
item.g:description: Add instant warmth and texture to any sofa, bed or reading nook with this diamond-quilted velvet cushion cover. Irresistibly soft with a subtle sheen and a plush, tactile finish, it layers beautifully with linen, knits and neutrals, and comes in a curated palette of eight rich colours to suit any space. Choose your size and shade, and style your own way.

item.g:title: Soft Cotton Face Washer Towels — 10 Pack (450GSM)
item.g:description: Wrap your everyday routine in softness with this set of 10 premium 450GSM cotton face washers. Beautifully plush yet quick-drying, with a satin-finish border and double-stitched hems that hold their shape wash after wash. Gentle on skin and endlessly useful for face, hands and travel, in a rich palette of eleven colours to suit any bathroom.

item.g:title: Oval Marble-Effect Coffee Table
item.g:description: A sculptural centrepiece for the living room, this oval coffee table pairs a smooth marble-effect top with a warm, angular timber-look base. The soft oval silhouette keeps the room feeling open, while the crossed legs add architectural interest, a timeless, mid-century-inspired piece that anchors a lounge with quiet luxury. Style it with a stack of design books, a low vase or a scented candle to complete the look.

item.g:title: Marble-Look Glass Table Set — 2 Piece (80cm)
item.g:description: A refined two-piece table set that brings a soft, luxe finish to any living space. Each table is topped with marble-look tempered glass, tough enough for everyday use yet elegant enough to feel like a designer piece. Nest them together for a compact footprint, or set them apart as a coffee table and matching side table. With clean lines and neutral marble tones, they layer effortlessly with sofas, rugs and accent chairs, an easy way to elevate a lounge, bedroom or reading corner.

item.g:title: Modern Coffee Table with Storage Drawer & Open Shelf
item.g:description: Style and storage in one considered piece. This modern coffee table pairs a sleek marble-look top with a smart two-tone body, a soft-close drawer keeps remotes, chargers and clutter neatly out of sight, while the open shelf is ideal for books, baskets or a styling tray. Raised on slender metal legs, it feels light and contemporary, the perfect centrepiece for a living room that likes to stay tidy and effortlessly put-together.

item.g:title: Ergolux Plus Ergonomic Mesh Office Chair with Footrest (Grey)
item.g:description: Work, study or game in all-day comfort with the Ergolux Plus ergonomic mesh office chair. The breathable mesh back keeps you cool through the longest sessions, while adaptive lumbar support, an adjustable headrest and 3D armrests shape the chair around you. Recline up to 140°, put your feet up on the retractable footrest, and glide silently on quiet castor wheels. Choose the model that suits you, from the everyday Core to the fully loaded Elite, each finished in a cool, contemporary grey.

item.g:description: Food-safe, resealable stand-up pouches that keep your product fresh and looking retail-ready — ideal for coffee, granola, nuts, dried fruit, spices, lollies, protein and pet treats. item.g:title: Amara Upholstered Bed Frame with 3 Drawers — Oat White
item.g:description: A bed that anchors the whole room. The Amara's bedhead runs extra wide and stands tall, softly padded and panelled with angled stitching that catches the light differently through the day, so the wall behind your bed stops being an afterthought. It is upholstered in a warm oat white that reads cream rather than grey, and sits on a sturdy slatted platform base, so your mattress needs no box spring underneath. Three deep drawers roll out on castors for spare linen, winter blankets and everything a bedroom quietly accumulates.
